resources.string: for people who buy their music
Your Bandcamp collection and your local files, together on one shelf. Streamed here, and yours to keep as real files on your phone.
The Meedwell mark, a copper coin resting in an open cradle

Bandcamp\'s API streams your collection but does not hand over the files. Download them from Bandcamp the way you always have, point Meedwell at the folder, and they join your shelf as what they are: files you own.
Lists live on this phone. Bandcamp\'s API can show playlists but offers no way to make or change one, so Meedwell keeps yours here rather than pretending they travel.
Bandcamp\'s API can add a heart but cannot remove one yet. To take this one off, use the Bandcamp website.
Your music on this phone is untouched and playing fine.

The last sync came back as a plain server error with no reason given, which is how Bandcamp answers a login it has rejected. Usually that means the password was regenerated on their side. Nothing on your shelf is lost.
Free no matter what. Nothing held back, nothing unlocked later. One person carries it.

Free no matter what. Nothing held back, nothing unlocked later. Built and carried by one person. If software made this way matters to you, there\'s a place to stand behind it. Either way, it\'s yours.
